description: The email address on record for each LinkedIn profile URL or handle: best address, its type (work or personal), all work addresses, plus name, title and employer. Addresses are read from a database, not guessed and not scraped. $8 per 1,000 profiles with an address; profiles without one are free. Use for a list the user already has; for people search by criteria use search_people.

maxChargeUsd.description: Maximum spend for this call in USD (default 5); the run stops at the cap and rows already delivered are the only ones charged

profileUrls.description: LinkedIn profile URLs or bare handles

name: find_email_by_linkedin_url
title: Email addresses for LinkedIn profile URLs
